ALLY SOLDIER:

SOLDIERS:

Use the provided SOLDIERS image only as the visual reference for the appearance of ordinary soldiers.

Create a very large army of ordinary soldiers.

Do not copy the composition or background from any character reference image.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

Only ONE Riven.

Only ONE Ally Soldier.

All other people are ordinary SOLDIERS.

The army is very large.

Many soldiers are visible around Riven and extending far along the road.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE image as the environment reference.

The entire video takes place on this mountain road at sunset.

Keep the mountain landscape, road, and fading sunset atmosphere consistent.

Do not use backgrounds from the character reference images.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human movement.

Natural armor, cloth, hair, and environmental physics.

Cinematic camera movement.

All dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Speak only the written dialogue.

Natural lip synchronization.

No additional dialogue.

No subtitles.

No text.

No watermark.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Riven and Ally Soldier are already standing still in the middle of the mountain road.

The large army is still marching past them.

Riven realizes that simply stopping herself will not stop the army.

She shouts for everyone to stop.

The soldiers gradually react and turn their attention toward her.

Riven then steps forward alone, leaving Ally Soldier behind.

She refuses to move and draws her sword.

Nobody attacks yet.


=== SCENE ===

Begin with a medium cinematic shot of Riven standing still on the mountain road.

Ally Soldier stands beside her.

The army has NOT stopped.

Many SOLDIERS continue walking past Riven and Ally Soldier on both sides.

Keep the soldiers moving naturally around them.

Riven watches the army continuing forward.

Her expression becomes firm.

She raises her head and shouts loudly:

"STOP!"

The camera begins pulling back from Riven into a wide cinematic view.

Soldiers closest to Riven hear her first.

They slow down and turn toward her.

Soldiers who have already walked past Riven begin stopping and looking back.

More soldiers farther along the road gradually notice.

The movement of the army slowly comes to a stop.

As the camera continues pulling back, reveal a very large military force spread across the mountain road.

Many SOLDIERS are visible around Riven and far into the background.

Riven remains calm.

Ally Soldier looks at her, surprised.

Riven steps forward alone.

Only Riven moves forward.

Ally Soldier stays where he is and watches her.

A nearby SOLDIER faces Riven and says:

"Riven. Move."

Riven stops.

She looks at the soldiers around her.

Riven reaches for her sword.

She slowly draws the large sword.

The nearby soldiers become tense and alert, but nobody attacks.

Ally Soldier remains behind Riven.

He does not draw his weapon.

Riven says:

"No. I'm protecting my home."

Hold on Riven standing alone with her sword drawn while the large army watches her.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven stands with her sword drawn.

The large army is focused on her.

Ally Soldier remains behind her without drawing his weapon.

Nobody has attacked yet.

Combat has not started.


=== MOOD ===

Tense.

Restrained.

Cinematic sunset atmosphere.

Riven is calm and determined.

The army feels large and intimidating.

The central visual idea is simple:

THE ARMY KEEPS MOVING.

RIVEN SHOUTS "STOP!"

THE SOLDIERS GRADUALLY STOP AND LOOK BACK.

RIVEN STEPS FORWARD ALONE.

RIVEN DRAWS HER SWORD.

CUT.、16:9
